Vehicle.Name: TIE Advanced V1
Vehicle.Description: [H3]TIE Advanced V1[h3] Sienar Fleet Systems designed the TIE advanced v1 to be a sturdy starfighter capable of operating independetly of fleet support. To achive this objective, it added shields, a hyperdrive, and armor plating. The ship's S-foils fold inward when the vesel lands to minimize its storage footprint. [P]Factories on Lothal made the initial production run for the TIE Advanced v1, but local rebels destroyed the first model. Once these ships were back in production, they quick;y became the primary transports for the Inquisitorius.

Mod.MiscDesc: [B]XX-23 S-Thread Tracer:[b] The missile constains a device allowing the target's movements to be tracked regardless of where it travels, including through hyperspace. [P]After a character makes a successful combat check with an XX-23 tracer, he may take an [B]Average([DI][DI]) Astrogation check[b] to determing the target's location anywhere in the galaxy until the tracer is removed.
